Bill.BriefDescription: Developing strategies to improve the energy efficiency of existing homes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing strategies to improve the energyefficiency of existing homes; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that Washington'shomeowners and utilities support voluntary and cost-effective measuresthat improve the energy efficiency of existing homes. The legislaturealso finds that energy audits and energy performance scoring methodsare available to assist homeowners in making informed decisions onenergy efficiency upgrades, and that Washington's local governments andutilities are leaders in initiating pilot projects to use energy auditsand other strategies to improve the energy efficiency of existinghomes. The legislature also finds that state and local programs onenergy efficiency should be compatible with pending federal energylegislation. It is the intent of the legislature to determineappropriate strategies to improve the energy efficiency of existinghomes.
